epistemic_thesis: A great trading city whose sole traded currency is unconsummated fantasy: strangers sheltering beneath rain-swept stone arcades never greet or touch, locking eyes for at most 1.0 second to weave luminous arrows, triangles, and stars of silent voluptuousness—yet the instant any two speak or touch, phantom turns to prosaic person and the entire carousel of fantasies shatters.

stones.calvino_token: Great city, chastest of cities, where people who move through the streets do not know one another; no one greets anyone; eyes lock for a second and flee.
stones.invariant: strangersKnowEachOther === false && greetingsExchanged === 0 while chaste; maxLockDurationSec <= 1.0

stones.calvino_token: At each encounter they imagine a thousand things: meetings, conversations, surprises, caresses, bites.
Downpour beneath the stone pavement arcades where strangers take shelter together.
stones.invariant: 7 vaulted stone portico bays over wet mirror flagstones with WebAudio rain patter & string-harmonic resonance

stones.calvino_token: 10 canonical figures sheltering and counter-promenading beneath the colonnade
An exchange of glances like lines that connect one figure with another and draw arrows, stars, triangles until all combinations are exhausted.
stones.invariant: Active 1-second eye-lock raycaster weaves directed arrows, 3-vertex triangles, and 5-vertex stars across the 10 strangers

stones.calvino_token: A silent voluptuous vibration trembles; if any begin to live their ephemeral dreams, every phantom becomes a person (pursuits, pretenses, misunderstandings, clashes, oppressions) and the carousel of fantasies stops.
stones.invariant: consummate(idA, idB) immediately sets chasteState='collapsed', carouselRunning=false, voluptuousVibration=0, activeArrowCount=0, activeTriangleCount=0, activeStarCount=0 until resetByRain()

inner_arch.chaste_equilibrium: Unspoken anonymity sustains high voluptuousVibration (0.65..0.98) and continuous geometric combinatorics (arrows, triangles, stars) across the 10 strangers.
inner_arch.causal_rupture: Forced speech or physical contact (consummate) collapses voluptuousness to 0.00, shatters all glance constellations into cold leaden shards, silences string harmonics with a flat prosaic thud, and shackles the pair in pursuits, pretenses, misunderstandings, clashes, and oppressions.
inner_arch.restoration: Only a fresh cloudburst wash (resetByRain) restores anonymity beneath the stone arcades and restarts the phantom carousel.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Rain-arcade silhouette shadow-theater & live 1-second combinatoric sightline star-raycaster with sul-ponticello string harmonic WebAudio

chloe-choreographer.role: Stone colonnade rain architecture, wet pavement reflections, all 10 canonical Calvino strangers in counter-promenade, and procedural rain + string-harmonic WebAudio.

chloe-phantom-geometry.role: 1.0-second max eye-lock raycaster, 5 unspoken reverie modes, emergent arrows/triangles/5-point stars, voluptuous vibration physics, and instant shatter on forced consummation.
